headline: Papers, Please-Min: the gate closes at 18:00
lede: The booth now has the original's shift clock: every day's budget is sized by its queue — eighteen seconds an applicant — so the thirteen-deep finale is the tightest shift of the week because it is the longest day. Dawdle and the gate slams on whoever is left in line; day seven must finish or the quota loses the week.

notes.text: sim.js tick()/close/quota with a shared morning rewind, real clock face on the wall (pips, sweeping hands, red last hour, per-second ticks, close buzzer, GATE CLOSED banner), all synthesized — no assets.

The clock shipped invisible once: the canvas top-right, provably clear of every canvas box, sits under the PAUSE/WATCH HTML overlays — screenshots caught what asserts can't see, so the clock now hangs on the ruled grid by the date line, pinned chrome-safe.

paperscheck 8596 with 18/18 mutants (four new on the clock) — human 10s cadence clears every seed, the clumsy eye still clears the week, dawdling closes day 1 and dies at a deterministic two-head finale quota; papersplay 30/30 real keys.

look.text: Papers, Please-Min — survive the week before the gate closes
